summary: Biodexa Pharmaceuticals PLC filed a Form 6-K on October 8, 2026 announcing a change to its American Depositary Share ratio, from one ADS representing fifty ordinary shares to one ADS representing four hundred ordinary shares, effective on or about October 26, 2026. ADS holders must mandatorily surrender old ADSs (CUSIP 59564R872) for new ADSs (CUSIP 59564R864) at one new ADS per eight old ADSs, equivalent to a one-for-eight reverse ADS split. Ordinary shares are unaffected. JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. is depositary; no fractional ADSs issued. Routine depositary ratio change, not a special situation; watch liquidity and any compliance-driven reverse-split motive.
